scope: Standalone two-system tie context; full first system plus owner-confirmed measure5 whole-note endpoint only; not full-score completion
confirmation: Actual GT13A6_OWNER_SOURCE_CONFIRMATION record and four packet hashes, source SHA, source-curve identities and review freeze must match; preserve bytes
whole_note: FreeSerif U+1D15D; GT05A canonical raster placement unchanged; same font size rule as existing black heads; no stem on whole note; preserved transparent center
synthetic_controls: Before score outputs: whole-note glyph at interlines14/18/24 and phases0/0.25/0.5/0.75; <=0.5px per axis measured bbox center; open center, deterministic bitmap and no rescaling
incoming_position: x from source head1923 bbox center, y from target diatonic pitch and exact staff2 middle polyline/interline; source physical center separately recorded
outgoing_position: Use unchanged frozen GT13A2/13A5 final head1852 rendered bounds and anchor; do not rerasterize any first-system event
ties: Reuse raw source cubic x/control geometry, uniform vertical displacement per segment from source head bbox bottom to target raster bbox bottom. Retain source attached-end horizontal/vertical offset. Compare declared target attachment per axis <=0.5px; preserve source length/curvature; separate masks in original system viewports
staff_and_context: Source staff2 polylines clipped exactly at m5 original right boundary639; existing header clef and target-key glyphs only, without repeat/time at system2; no invented other measures, chords or lyrics
ledgers: Existing ledger width2 and pitch-position rule; cover whole-note bbox plus4px to either side, preserving holes in head alpha; intentional head/ledger contacts counted separately
collision: Every nonzero alpha counts; no exact contact with existing fixed first-system score or new unrelated second-system context. Report nearest distances. Reject clipping, missing endpoints, pitch/role disagreement or gap bridge
pixel_integrity: All differences against generated before-tie canvas must lie inside new tie alpha only; first-system layer bytes remain unchanged. This is not source-ink edit authorization
result_policy: Freeze new predictions before assistant visual review; do not tune to target references; no target reference access; rendering and visual verdicts separate from source confirmation
